purpose: Active champion pool used by evaluate.py (HISTORY_DIR). roster/ is the full archive.
selection: difficulty + distinctness, not rank: field is 97.1% transitive (6 upsets/210 pairs), so lower-ranked agents add games without adding selection pressure. Top-10 median similarity as opponents is 89%, so rank alone would buy one axis of difficulty.
evidence: 4200 games, 21 agents, 10 seeds x 2 seats per pairing, 0 errors
cost: 8 champions x 40 matches = 320 games per candidate evaluation
excluded: ranks 11-21 sit >=1103 BT-Elo below rank 10 and lose 59-89% of games
